notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q2136142_redbird_reef.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. A patch about 400 m across of the reef at about 24 m: 110 Redbird subway cars (a sample of the 997), stripped of wheels, doors and windows, lying in loose rows where they were dropped, some on their sides; eight Army tanks and a tug. The layout is approximate. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
